```{r chart_avgRTBreakdown, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))

unique_files <- sort(unique(raw_data$app_name))

plots <- map(unique_files, function(f) {
  file_data <- raw_data %>%
    filter(app_name == f) %>%
    mutate(executionGroup = thread_group)  # Ensure executionGroup is present for grouping

  composition_data <- file_data %>%
    group_by(app_name, run_id, executionGroup, label, test_name) %>%
    summarise(avg_rt = mean(elapsed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  if (nrow(composition_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 20px; color: #999; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("No data available for: ", f)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  all_unique_labels <- sort(unique(composition_data$label))
  set.seed(42)
  transaction_colors <- setNames(choose_palette(length(all_unique_labels)), all_unique_labels)

  composition_data <- composition_data %>%
    mutate(
      label                = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels),
      run_id               = factor(run_id, levels = sort(unique(run_id))),
      executionGroup_clean = str_trunc(as.character(executionGroup), width = 25),
      axis_string          = interaction(executionGroup_clean, run_id, sep = " | ")
    )

  total_rt       <- compute_total_rt(composition_data, "avg_rt") %>% compute_label_x()
  num_rows       <- n_distinct(composition_data$axis_string)
  dynamic_height <- max(400, (num_rows * 25) + 150)

  subtitle_text  <- build_run_testname_subtitle(composition_data)

  p <- ggplot(
    composition_data,
    aes(
      y    = axis_string,
      x    = avg_rt,
      fill = label,
      text = paste0(
        "Scenario: ",      executionGroup,
        "\nRun ID: ",      run_id,
        "\nTransaction: ", label,
        "\nTest: ",        tools::file_path_sans_ext(f),
        "\nAvg RT: ",      round(avg_rt, 0), "ms"
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(
      stat      = "identity",
      position  = "stack",
      color     = "#222222",
      linewidth = 0.1,
      width     = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data        = total_rt,
      aes(
        x     = label_x,
        y     = interaction(executionGroup_clean, run_id, sep = " | "),
        label = paste0(" ", round(total_rt, 0), "ms"),
        text  = NULL
      ),
      hjust       = 0,
      color       = "black",
      fontface    = "bold",
      size        = 2.5,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = transaction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x    = "Total Cumulative Average Response Time (ms)",
      y    = "Scenario | Run ID",
      fill = "Label"
    ) +
    facet_grid(executionGroup_clean ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "right",
      strip.text.y     = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(r = 15), hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 12, color = "#333", family = "Consolas", margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 12, color = "#333", family = "Consolas", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      plot.margin      = margin(10, 40, 20, 10)
    )

  pl <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  # Force equal panel heights
  num_facets    <- n_distinct(composition_data$executionGroup_clean)
  domain_height <- 1 / num_facets
  gap           <- 0.02

  for (i in seq_len(num_facets)) {
    ax_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)
    top     <- 1 - (i - 1) * (domain_height)
    bottom  <- top - domain_height + gap
    pl$x$layout[[ax_name]]$domain <- c(bottom, top)
  }

  layout_config <- list(
    showlegend = TRUE,
    margin     = list(l = 80, r = 40, b = 80, t = 80),
    dragmode   = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
    height     = dynamic_height,
    width      = NULL,
    title      = list(
      text    = paste0(
        "<b>Avg Response Times Breakdown: ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f),
        "
<sup>", subtitle_text, "</sup></b>"
      ),
      x       = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
    ),
    xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(
      title      = list(text = "", standoff = 50),
      fixedrange = TRUE,
      autorange  = "reversed",
      automargin = TRUE
    )
  )

  for (i in 1:10) {
    x_name <- if (i == 1) "xaxis" else paste0("xaxis", i)
    y_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)

    if (i == 1) {
      layout_config[[x_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
      layout_config[[y_name]]$automargin <- TRUE
    } else {
      layout_config[[x_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
      layout_config[[y_name]] <- list(
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        autorange  = "reversed",
        automargin = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  pl <- do.call(layout, c(list(pl), layout_config)) %>%
    plotly::config(
      responsive     = TRUE,
      displayModeBar = TRUE,
      toImageButtonOptions = list(
        format   = "png",
        filename = paste0("Avg_RT_Breakdown_", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f), "_", Sys.Date()),
        height   = dynamic_height,
        width    = 1400
      ),
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
        "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
        "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
      )
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
      pl
    ),
    render_observation_panel(
      chart_id = paste0(
        "chart_avgRTBreakdown_",
        f
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
)
```
